title: 2x Climbing French Bean ‘Cobra’ Plug Plants – RHS Award Winner, Heavy Crop
description:
2x Climbing French Bean ‘Cobra’ Plug Plants

An

 RHS Award of Garden Merit

winner and one of the most reliable French beans you can grow.

 Phaseolus vulgaris

‘Cobra’ is a vigorous climber, producing

 heavy yields

of long, straight, sweetly flavoured beans over a long season. The attractive pale violet flowers make it beautiful enough for the ornamental garden as well as the vegetable patch.
